text:
marta: Quick sync thinking out loud: our Dedicated warm pool needs a refresh. Autoscaler tokens + headroom still leave us with cold-GPU tails on large-model tenants. Proposal: a tiny model-aware warm layer plus conservative packing rules (instead of relying only on credit headroom).

kevin: clarifying q by model-aware you mean tagging cache/weights per model and keeping GPUs primed for those models?

marta: exactly. two inputs: per-model recent request rate + tenant SLA. Forecast active replicas -> desired_warm_slots per model. When safe, pack multiple small models on one GPU.

elaine: packing = fragmentation risk. how do we handle runtime mismatches (quant, seq len)?

marta: only pack when runtime-compatible: same quantization & similar seq profile. otherwise give soft isolation. allocations carry compatibility tags.

santiago: forecasting approach? simple windows or an ML predictor? what windows?

marta: two-level forecast: short window (5m EWMA alpha=0.3) for spikes and 1h baseline for trend. desired = max(short_pred * sla_multiplier, baseline_pred * 0.6). SLA affects multiplier.

ryan: add a cold-start safety floor: desired_warm >= ceil(cold_start_ms / avg_request_interval_ms) so we don't underprovision for slow spin-ups.

kevin: ownership: control-plane computes desired_warm and emits intent, operator performs physical allocation + packing?

marta: yes. intent = {model, tenant, warm_slots, compatibility_tags, priority}. operator maps to host/GPU and applies placement constraints.

elaine: cost control idea: tier warm slots into guaranteed / best-effort / preemptible. lower-tier tenants get preemptible warms.

marta: agreed. fallback rules: if guaranteed unavailable, downgrade to best-effort; if still insufficient for high-SLA, route to lighter model variant (quantized) if tenant configured opt-in.

santiago: rollout: canary predictor on small tenant subset. add metrics: warm_cache_hit_rate (per model), packing_fragmentation_pct.

ryan: ops needs drain semantics so operator can evict warms safely. Add eviction safepoints & grace windows to avoid mid-request cache loss.

kevin: when co-locating tenants ensure KV cache privacy. no cross-tenant sharing even if processes share GPU.

marta: isolation enforced at process/container boundary; encryption keys and memory separation intact.

elaine: metrics to add: predicted_vs_actual_warm_slots and alert if warm_cache_hit_rate drops below threshold for 10m.

ryan: experiment checklist: 1) extend intent API with warm_slots & tags, 2) operator packing + compatibility matcher, 3) short/long forecaster, 4) canary 10 tenants with mixed SLAs, 5) dashboards + alerts.

santiago: Ill own operator packing & matching. ryan owns drain semantics. marta owns forecaster + control-plane intent. kevin + elaine do canary metrics + security review.

marta: ops-bot create canary ticket and provision tenant list?

ops-bot: Created ticket INF-6421: warm-pool-model-aware-canary. Checklist: forecaster, intent field, operator packing, canary tenants, dashboards. Assignees: santiago, ryan, marta, kevin, elaine. ETA 3 weeks. :white_check_mark:

kevin: one more detail fallback routing to smaller quantized variants must be opt-in via tenant config flag.

marta: noted. default off for now; enable per-tenant during canary. I'll write the intent schema + link PR to INF-6421. Thanks everyone.
